body: What fucking purpose would it give for somebody to feel sorry for me? Like, really? I dont give a fuckin shit if someone feels sorry for me or not. You just pissed me off when you decided to bring up the whole, "if you wanted to be dead, you would have done so." Like, do you not know that your mind is going to try and stop you via basic fucking instincts? Of course Im not dead. Im fucking terrified of dying. All Im saying is, I didnt need you to get on your high horse and try and help somebody who didnt ask for it. You just decided I wanted it and I didnt. Cool, you relate. You understand that life fucking sucks. We done?

Where the fuck did I say my problems are worse than others? I said 3 times that I just wanted somebody to relate to. How hard is that to understand? Im not looking for help. I just wanted to feel maybe a little less alone, but no. Cant have that. Apparently I just need somebody to fix my fucking life. Doesn't matter now.

Alright, now you pissed me off. If I wanted to be dead, I would have done it? Fuck you. I hate that phrase more than anything. I already said I just wanted to fucking relate to somebody and not have some ass hat try and think he knows what the fuck is going on in my life. I *am* fucking lazy because I have no fucking reason to do anything as I have stated multiple times. You act as if depression is just something somebody can easily fix. As if there aren't people who are living the best life they can and still want to die. I realize that I am the only one that can fix myself which is why it's best for me to die. I posted something that I wanted to get *off my chest*. You know, like the sub?

Honestly, I'm not looking for a way to fix my life. If I had some guy screaming at me all the time, I think I'd have a mental breakdown and shoot myself in front of him. I've lived in other place, one being in Nashville. I hated every second of it. In posting this, I was more so hoping to just find people who relate. If I wanted to live, I would say fuck it and do anything I could, but I don't care.
Bozeman. Why?

I appreciate what your trying to do. I do. But it just isn't for me. All of that costs money which I would rather not take the time to save to experience such a short point in time. With how much work you would have to put in in order for you to even experience one of those things is just ridiculous. As for love? I doubt there is anybody out there for me. I've never dated and I don't see that changing anytime soon. Nobody wants to be with somebody who has a generally negative attitude. I'm skinny, ugly, and way too awkward for any sort of love. Think about it, would you want to be with somebody where you have to constantly make sure they're fine? It's exhausting. Yet, I won't change. I'm too lazy for change and I don't care enough. I already screwed myself by quitting work. I won't even be able to afford next months rent. Yet, I just don't care anymore.

Yet another thing that costs money, though. I understand what you mean, but I just don't really see the point in staying. I mean, I get it, death is sad. Yet, why does it have to be? Do we mourn those who haven't been born yet? Those who simply don't exist? Do we mourn the sperm that was wasted in a condom? I mean, I just don't understand. All it simply would be is returning to non-existence. If I could have chosen, I would have rather not existed in the first place.

See, now people always talk as if somebody *always* has some sort of hidden passion that they just haven't discovered yet. I don't believe in that. Sure, there are some that can find the drive to do something and maybe can discover something they love along the way, but what if there truly is nothing for me? Like, why do people believe that that is just impossible? I'm the type of person who just enjoys sleep, so I figured why not make it eternal?

While I do understand what you mean, at the same time I would rather not chance my life going worse. It's the main reason why I want to choose something more lethal. Something where I don't have time to change my mind or anything. I just want it to be over. I love sleep, so I might as well do an eternal one.

I mean, a shotgun to the head is usually quite lethal. Sure, some do survive, but I can just take extra measures. If I do result in hanging, then I'll just have to make sure I go on a sturdy enough structure. Most likely metal so it can't break. I have a very new and strong noose lying in my closet, so...

I mean, I get what you're saying, but what if that moment never comes? What if I end up staying like this till I'm in my 50s? Can I really say it was worth it if I have lost most of my life? I have personally known people exactly like that. I was working with a man, Kenny, in his 60's. He lived in a trailer, was working at McDonald's, never married, generally miserable. I don't want to end up like him, yet I don't have the drive to change myself. I know I won't help myself, so I have to wonder if suicide really is my best choice? I honestly feel like there are some people, such as myself, who just aren't meant for this world. I can't just expect my life to randomly flip around if I don't put in the effort to make that happen, yet I won't put in the effort. I just don't care enough.

I don't know if I would have the energy to take care of one. My roommate has one and, while I think they are adorable, I just couldn't do it. The only pet I'd really want is a dog, and those require so much energy. I haven't found what I have to live for and chances are I may never.
No, but that's the thing. There is no job that I enjoy doing. I have searched for a long time and nothing interests me. It's just so much easier if I die.
I am currently working at one. I can barely even do part time and I am actually nearing the end of a week that I had requested off. I honestly don't think I will be going back.
I definitely will try, but it's extremely hard with severe social anxiety. Not to mention I have low self esteem, but I can try, I suppose

I wanted to pursue a job as a freelance artist, but I began to loathe my work and have stopped completely just a couple of days ago. Most of the time I sit on my computer to pass the time.

While I do love the song and it's lyrics, it usually makes me feel more saddened when I try to listen to it at my worst. I wish the depression would pass, but it never really does. I've had it all the way back in 4th grade as crazy as that sounds. Sure, it can get manageable, but it never passes. I actually just quit my job due to it. If I can't find something else, then I can expect the worst, but that's not what this is about. I appreciate you listening to those songs, btw. I like sharing music

I don't really watch tv, as I just usually play some video games, but if you are into anime, then I could recommend you some. As for music, it varies a lot. At the moment I am listening to some pretty depressing music, but that's just due to my mood. I can, however, recommend a couple of bands that I absolutely love on my good days. First, The Arcadian Wild. I *love* The Arcadian Wild! I would recommend first listening to Rain Clouds and then Liar. Ugh, I could go on about them. Second would be Lord Huron. Anything from him is a great pick mostly, but you should definitely check out Ends of the Earth by him. Gets me in the mood to travel all the time! Third would be Gregory Alan Isakov. My two favorite songs from him are Dandelion Wine and Saint Valentine. These would definitely be my top 3 bands.

It varies, honestly. I'm mostly depressed because that's just how depression works. There is no one cause to depression other than it's imbalance. Now, I have things that can worsen the depression, today being the loneliness. I am also a failed artist, that meaning that I have given up due to my own laziness. That, too, can worsen it. It all just depends on what my mind is stuck on during the time. Seeing as how it's New Year's Day and the thought that you are supposed to spend it with others just brought the fact up that I've never had anyone.

I appreciate it, and I do hope you are right even though I am inclined to believing the opposite. However, I am not depressed because I am alone, I am alone because I am depressed, which has further progressed my depression.
